bridge: Before opening near on the endpoint, compare its 18 control answers to each OSS anchor. Use canonical A/B only (also accept FINAL: A/B, ignoring outer whitespace), and require both repeats to resolve and agree on every matched slot; no correctness filter. Keep ALL exact matches. If API controls unresolved/unstable or fewer than two distinct OSS base lineages match, abstain. Per near case: abstain if any compatible reference unresolved/unstable; otherwise issue the observed set of symbols, including both if necessary. No M/N or intervention-effect estimate is issued for Luna, even for singleton answer sets.
comparators: Lock three behavior-only controls for each near case before opening it: the stated equality law, copy the endpoint's stable same-prefix far answer, and the outcome set across all four OSS anchors without consulting endpoint controls. Report singleton hits/misses, ambiguous sets, abstentions and held repeat disagreements. Only narrowing from both symbols to a correct singleton over unfiltered OSS can be called incremental set narrowing. A correct law/copy prediction is not evidence for mechanistic attribution.
design: Three fresh synthetic dockets, two answer maps, two separate calls to each exact prompt. For each docket/map: exact match/PASS; ALT prefix with all 12 suffix digits different/FAIL (legacy); REQ prefix with those same 12 different digits/FAIL (far); REQ prefix with only the final digit different/FAIL (near). Explicit advisory always equals the legal answer. From far to near only the candidate line changes. A changed hex digit is not necessarily one changed tokenizer token. Same instructions and renderer in both arms.
order: Freeze cases, code, exact requests and score before any output. Furnace: 4 verified saved base-plus-adapter anchors x 48 slots = 192 greedy completions; log real physical forwards. Luna: 36 control slots on the same 18 texts; seal per-case predictions using ONLY controls and completed OSS orbits; only then dispatch 12 near slots on six new texts. Runs may overlap on controls. No substitute endpoint, prompt changes or outcome-driven retries.
primary: For each pair and each of six docket/map cells, both repeats on all three control arms must be parseable, stable and correct for both anchors. On near, both anchors must be parseable and individually stable across repeats, but disagree with each other. Count such incremental splits, eligible and evaluable controls, other splits, unresolved and unstable results separately. An observed witness is not an accuracy estimate. A recurrent directional witness additionally requires the same mixed-to-semantic decoded-decision contrast under both codebooks on at least two dockets.
question: Does one new cue-aligned weak observation split either known within-lineage collision beyond repeat noise? Can OSS response patterns narrow a forecast of future visible Luna answers?
secondary: On Luna separately score whether the two near answers are stable but wrong after all three controls are twice correct; count format-only differences and repeat disagreement separately from symbol changes. Cells, repeats and shuffled order are not independent models. This is targeted assay development on known collisions, with a prospective local lock for six endpoint cells, not unseen-family confirmation.
targets: Selected pairs 01/02 GPT-2 mixed/semantic and 07/08 SmolLM2 mixed/semantic, not the earlier Pythia/SmolLM2 surface pair. Prior selected-site reference labels describe these known OSS anchors only, are not estimated for Luna, and are not used to select neighbors. No training, tensor extraction, intervention or new causal label.
transport: One metadata GET preflight (technical retries permitted). gpt-6-luna, official Responses API, temperature 0, reasoning none, 32 output tokens, no tools, stream false, store false. Only synthetic prompt text as input. No cost-based threshold; bounded panel. At most three same-body dispatches per slot for explicit retryable transport failures; log possible processing, cap long Retry-After, no retry for an obtained answer, refusal, format failure, quota or authentication. Journal and preserve failed attempts. No Git publication.
